description: Web page to markdown: give a public URL, get its main content as clean Markdown for LLMs (navigation, footers and scripts removed) with title, canonical URL, language, publish date and links. Use when an agent needs to read, quote or summarise a page. Respects robots.txt, ai.txt and noai; no paywall bypass; refusals are not charged. Signed receipt. Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base or XRP on XRPL). The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict. Example arguments: {"url":"https://example.org/"}.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of one page

name: page_to_markdown

outputSchema.description: Paid result: { data, receipt }. Unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired object instead (isError: true).

data.description: Main page content as Markdown with title, canonical URL, language, publish date and links

provenance.description: The response includes a `provenance` block (sg-provenance/1): each fact carries its source, source URL, retrieval time and limits; evidence only, no score, rating or verdict.

receipt.description: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt; verify free with the verify_receipt tool or POST /v1/verify-receipt. New receipts carry a signed `evidence` object: service_version, data_timestamp, validation, terms_version, terms_hash, provenance_hash.

title: Web Page to Markdown
